verdict: Leads and efficiency improving; key build milestones remain overdue.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 97 leads at a cost of $18.74 per lead, and the most recent week showed leads up 11.54% with cost per lead down 5.36% — a meaningful step in the right direction. All 97 leads traced to Meta; Google Ads consumed $436.88 this period with no confirmed conversions recorded, meaning that spend is not yet pulling its weight. Separately, Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply over the last several days — down 42% week-over-week — and is being investigated now. Several build milestones originally scheduled for July through September have not yet launched, including landing pages, search campaigns, and CRM automation; completing these is the clearest path to scaling what is already working on Meta.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, with cost per lead falling to $18.74
lead volume growth this week versus the prior week
spent on Google Ads this period with zero confirmed conversions returned

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions collapsed in the last three days — from roughly 51 actions per day on average down to zero — and pipeline visibility is currently limited by a CRM connection issue, meaning incoming leads cannot be confirmed as entering intake.
watch_item.fix: Both are being addressed this week: the GBP drop is under active investigation and the CRM connection is being restored so lead flow can be tracked end to end.
